card.name: Section heading punctuation in drug labels
card.fires_on: Bullet marks, colons and the dot in section numbers like 2.4, placed right after a short heading or section label in a drug label. The next text is the start of that section's content.

modes.label: Bullet or colon after heading
modes.description: A bullet or colon right after a subsection heading such as Stability and Storage or Clinical Impact.
modes.example: Stability and Storage<< •>> Protect the admixed PN solution from light

modes.label: Dot in section numbers
modes.description: The dot or first digit inside a numbered section like 2.3 or 2.4 in the dosage section.
